crossRefs.note: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him…
He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will…
I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I…
If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you…
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men;
translations.bsb: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. When he does wrong, I will discipline him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.
translations.kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
